verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a per-token, self-serve pricing model for serverless inference ("Call 100+ open-source models with per-token pricing"), and community reports (e.g., a specific $0.0001/1K token price and sign-up with $25 credit) show founders can access and test real prices without contacting sales. Missing for 10: an explicit public pricing page listing every model's rate and confirmation that all hosted models (not just serverless) have visible per-token prices.
